name: ai-video-motion-replica
description: Replicate dance, martial-arts and fight motion in AI video with a clean white-model depth reference, then repaint characters and scenes from reference images.

interface.shortDescription: White-model workflow for controllable action AI video.
interface.longDescription: Turn a reference dance or fight video into a white-model depth reference, generate character turnaround sheets and an empty scene, then render the final clip with MiniMax H3 or Libtv while keeping the original motion, blocking and camera movement.
defaultPrompt: 用 $ai-video-motion-replica 把这段参考视频的动作复刻成我的角色。
用白模流程做一段街舞多人齐舞视频。
